consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the Grateful Dead at the Capitol Theater on November 6, 1970, highlighting the energy and intensity of the show. Many reviewers note the standout moments in the extended jams, particularly those featuring Pigpen's contributions, which are seen as some of the best of the era.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 45 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While the performance is highly regarded, the sound quality issues noted by several reviewers lead to a mixed overall sentiment.
